blocks.prompt: 4 If 5 is the harmonic mean between 2 and \(b\), find \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do numbers mein se ek (2) aur un ka harmonic mean (5) diya hai; doosra number \(b\) dhoondna hai.
Is ke liye H.M. ka formula \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\) kaam aayega.
Plan: values formula mein rakho, cross-multiply karo, aur simple equation hal karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 2 aur \(b\) ka H.M. 5 hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(b\).
Tareeqa: Do numbers \(a\) aur \(b\) ka H.M. \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\) hota hai. Jab H aur ek number maloom ho to yeh formula seedhi ek equation de deta hai jis mein sirf \(b\) unknown hai.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[5 = \dfrac{2(2)(b)}{2 + b}\]
\[5 = \dfrac{4b}{2 + b}\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\) aur \(H = 5\) rakh diye. Upar \(2 \times 2 \times b = 4b\).

Cross-multiply karein
\[5(2 + b) = 4b\]
\[10 + 5b = 4b\]
Kyun: Fraction khatam karne ke liye dono taraf \((2 + b)\) se multiply kiya. Bracket kholte waqt 5 ko dono terms se multiply karna hai: \(5 \times 2\) aur \(5 \times b\).

Equation hal karein
\[5b - 4b = -10\]
\[b = -10\]
Kyun: \(b\) wali terms ek taraf aur number doosri taraf. 10 doosri taraf ja kar \(-10\) ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: Negative jawab dekh kar ghabrayein nahi; H.P. ki terms negative bhi ho sakti hain. Bas tasdeeq zaroor karein.

Tasdeeq
\[H = \dfrac{2(2)(-10)}{2 + (-10)} = \dfrac{-40}{-8} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Wapas formula mein rakhne se H waqai 5 aata hai. Doosri tasdeeq: reciprocals \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{5}, -\frac{1}{10}\) mein har dafa \(-\frac{3}{10}\) ka farq hai, to yeh A.P. hai aur 2, 5, \(-10\) H.P. hai. Answer key bhi \(-10\) deti hai.
